nodes.rationale: If deleting a module makes complexity vanish it was a pass-through; if complexity reappears across callers it earned its keep.

nodes.rationale: Keep 12 (error threshold) and 14 (planner fill) apart: changing the fill level reshuffles every base plan and breaks saved edits. API always plans at 17 and ignores max_credits_per_semester.

nodes.norm_label: plan overrides (add/remove/move by instance_id, override_* warnings)
nodes.rationale: Overrides are saved against an older plan, so they follow the plan when it changes (OVERRIDE_REMOVE_RELOCATED, OVERRIDE_TERM_BEFORE_START); they warn instead of failing; remove wins on conflict.

nodes.label: Overloaded-term relief (OVERRIDE_COURSE_RELIEVED)
nodes.rationale: Catalog corrections keep changing the base plan and saved swaps must survive; only the planner's own courses are moved, never student edits, foundation courses or co-requisite pairs.

nodes.label: Kernel-enforced concurrency limit (close_browser required)
nodes.rationale: Free plan allows 1 concurrent browser via cross-process file locks; a forgotten close_browser blocks the next launch.

nodes.label: Temporary (throwaway) profile option
nodes.rationale: Keeps untrusted agent browsing out of logged-in profiles; temp profiles are never swept automatically.

nodes.rationale: Spoofing inside the Chromium kernel keeps Canvas/WebGL/audio/fonts/timezone and TLS coherent, unlike patched headless browsers; not a guaranteed pass against enterprise bot managers.

nodes.norm_label: supply chain pinning (exact versions, no npx latest)
nodes.rationale: npx re-resolves the package on every launch; installing a reviewed version pins code. The browser kernel is a closed-source binary from a small vendor and phones home for licensing.

nodes.norm_label: everything the browser returns is untrusted input

nodes.rationale: generate_plan translates completed/in-progress/retake codes so a transcript with an old number (COS 4060 -> COS 3060) satisfies the new requirement.

nodes.rationale: program_sequence_rules parses them into SequenceRules which the scheduler (_eligible_for_term) plans by and graduation_checks.sequence_check audits.

nodes.norm_label: placement waivers (cos 1020, inf 1030, mlc; mat 1000 / eng 1000 auto-waiver)
nodes.rationale: A waived course satisfies its requirement with no credits; replace_with_elective adds its credits to electives. Foundation courses are waived automatically when the student moved past them (_foundation_courses_moved_past).

nodes.label: Program options (concentrations, language focus; block roles elective/required/collateral)
nodes.norm_label: program options (concentrations, language focus; block roles elective/required/collateral)

nodes.label: Class standing by earned credits (27/57/87)
nodes.rationale: Earned credits include transfer credits and completed courses outside the planning pool, minus placement waivers.

nodes.label: Catalog data pipeline (offline build -> runtime JSON)
nodes.norm_label: catalog data pipeline (offline build -> runtime json)
nodes.rationale: PDF and Excel are parsed only at build time into compact JSON artifacts in backend/data; runtime never parses the PDF or Excel, it loads the artifacts once via getCatalogCache().

nodes.label: policy_overrides.json (hand-edited catalog corrections)
nodes.rationale: Wrong catalog facts (credits, prereqs, coreqs, degree total, program courses) are fixed here, never in engine code; policy credits win over Excel and PDF values.

nodes.norm_label: 'program choice' block convention (count in rule_text, empty courses_required)
nodes.rationale: Otherwise minor-proximity counts it twice and the OR-detection splits it.
